name: Gibo no Milk wa Mitsu no Aji ~Ippai Nonde, Amaete ne~
original_name: 義母のミルクは蜜の味 ～いっぱい飲んで、甘えてね～
source:
The main character, Yuuki Okazaki, is a college student who fells starved for affection.
He lives with his step mother and his father is away for the business.
One day, Yuuki could not resist the temptation to drink her mother milk.
And the scene was spotted out by her!
That is the beginning of their forbidden sex life...
